unitAndLibrary.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit apps/storefront/lib

fullBrowser.scope: Complete implementation before final country-selector and labeled-base-price presentation refinements

finalFocusedBrowser.scope: Final country/state controls, mobile contextual pricing through checkout, failed-save retention, disabled-rule fallback and global availability edits

limitations: Local synthetic acceptance does not establish real payment receipt, email delivery, merchant configuration or public ingress acceptance.
Shipping now qualifies against post-discount merchandise subtotal, including stores without rules.
Preview does not reserve stock, capacity, credit or promotion usage.
Customer-group and quantity pricing, multiple currencies, promotion stacking and shipping-only coupon benefits are outside this version.
